Method of Attack: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in Apache Log4j2 (CVE-2021-44228, CVE-2021-45046, CVE-2021-45105, CVE-2021-44832) allowing remote code execution via malicious JNDI URI in JDBC Appender
Impacted Systems: Systems running Apache Log4j2 versions 2.0-beta7 to 2.17.0 (excluding fixed versions 2.3.2 and 2.12.4)
Attack Vector: Modification of log configuration files to include malicious JNDI URIs executed via JDBC Appender
